body: Live workaround (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-12 16:34Z), holding until the Claude weekly limit resets (Oct 17, 4pm America/Los_Angeles, which is Oct 17 23:00Z). Claude /review-code children spawned with the default model run as "opus[1m]". From about 16:04Z they fail with "You've hit your weekly limit · resets Oct 17, 4pm (America/Los_Angeles)" (w-030c round 1, sessions 12241 and 12242). Spawning the Claude reviewer with model:"sonnet" WORKS (CSharpProof w-030c round 2, session-12249), so the limit is per model. A Sonnet reviewer is still the Claude vendor, so it satisfies the review pair's "one Codex and one Claude". Kimi may NOT stand in for Claude outside Greg's narrowed simple-isolated scope (memory greg-decision-2026-10-06-temporary-kimi-for-claude). If Sonnet is also refused, the Claude review and landing wait for availability. Some root Claude sessions, including the coordinator, also briefly hit the limit around 16:04Z; Opus2 covered gate contact.
